name: NGC 6256 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6256, a globular cluster in the Milky Way's bulge, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc6256-hubble
story: An ancient globular cluster hidden behind heavy dust toward the Milky Way's crowded bulge. Its orbit keeps it entirely within the bulge.

claims.text: NGC 6256 is an ancient, heavily obscured bulge globular cluster
Its orbit is confined within the bulge
NGC 6256 is one of the inner Milky Way globular clusters of Hubble program 15065
